navigator.title: College Navigator profile (fall 2024 admissions summary, 2024-25 costs)

stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class); Morgan State does not appear to publish a Common Data Set (none found on its Institutional Research or Fact Book pages), so GPA, residency and international applicant splits are not available. College Navigator (fall 2024): 23,366 applicants, 82% admitted, 12% of admits enrolled. Undergraduate enrollment 8,300 and 562 nonresident-alien undergraduates are IPEDS fall 2023 (full-time plus part-time). Morgan's own release reports an average high school GPA of 3.16 for the fall 2024 class.
